program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    raw = [(39.8, 21.4), (39.86, 21.44), (39.83, 21.5), (39.9, 21.55), (39.97, 21.52)]
    pts = np.array(raw)
    for _ in range(5):
        q = []
        for a, b in zip(pts[:-1], pts[1:]):
            q += [0.75 * a + 0.25 * b, 0.25 * a + 0.75 * b]
        pts = np.vstack([pts[0], q, pts[-1]])
    seg = [_haversine(a, b) for a, b in zip(pts[:-1], pts[1:])]
    s = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(seg)])
    n = int(s[-1] / 0.1)
    samp = np.array([[np.interp(d, s, pts[:, 0]), np.interp(d, s, pts[:, 1])] for d in np.arange(n + 1) * 0.1])
    heading = [_bearing(a, b) for a, b in zip(samp[:-1], samp[1:])]
    dh = [(b - a + 180) % 360 - 180 for a, b in zip(heading[:-1], heading[1:])]
    bank = [max(-12, min(12, 25 * d)) for d in dh]
    height = [450.0] * len(samp)
    raw_h = [_bearing(a, b) for a, b in zip(raw[:-1], raw[1:])]
    raw_dh = [(b - a + 180) % 360 - 180 for a, b in zip(raw_h[:-1], raw_h[1:])]
    spacing = [_haversine(a, b) for a, b in zip(samp[:-1], samp[1:])]
    keys = [{'t': round(i / 30, 4), 'lng': float(p[0]), 'lat': float(p[1]), 'alt_m': height[i], 'heading': float(heading[min(i, len(heading) - 1)]), 'bank': float(bank[min(i, len(bank) - 1)])} for i, p in enumerate(samp)]
    path = jw(wd / 'flight-path.json', keys)
    im = Image.new('RGB', (480, 360), (12, 16, 24))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    lo0, lo1, la0, la1 = (39.78, 40.0, 21.38, 21.57)
    P = lambda p: ((p[0] - lo0) / (lo1 - lo0) * 480, 360 - (p[1] - la0) / (la1 - la0) * 360)
    d.line([P(p) for p in raw], fill=(120, 60, 60), width=1)
    d.line([P(p) for p in samp], fill=(56, 189, 248), width=2)
    im.save(wd / 'corridor.png')
    worst_turn = max((abs(x) for x in dh))
    sgn_ok = all(((b > 0) == (h > 0) for b, h in zip(bank, dh) if abs(h) > 0.05))
    return ([check('samples every 0.1 km along the smoothed corridor', max((abs(x - 0.1) for x in spacing[:-1])) < 0.002, [min(spacing[:-1]), max(spacing[:-1])], 0.1), check('constant camera height', len(set(height)) == 1, height[0], 450), check('heading = bearing of the path tangent; it never snaps (max turn per 0.1 km <= 8 deg)', worst_turn <= 8, worst_turn, '<= 8 deg'), check('bank leans into each turn (same sign as the curvature), capped at 12 deg', sgn_ok and max(map(abs, bank)) <= 12, [min(bank), max(bank)], '|bank| <= 12'), check('negative control: the raw waypoint polyline snaps its heading at a vertex by > 30 deg', max((abs(x) for x in raw_dh)) > 30, raw_dh, '> 30 deg')], [path, wd / 'corridor.png'])
